verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents programmatic usage export through the FOCUS API, though it is only in Public Preview. Its billing insights show consumption broken down by resource type, and costs also appear in a Managed Grafana Cost and Usage zone. Nothing shows that spend can be attributed by team or workload, e.g. through labels, tags, or per-cluster or per-namespace allocation. Missing for 10: documented team/workload cost attribution, a generally available (non-preview) billing API, API reference depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
